title: "is a no-op" test has zero assertions — only proves no-throw
detail: Named "is a no-op" and comments "no listener bound," yet contains zero assert.* calls — it only confirms the call doesn't throw. A broken bail-out that still bound a listener would pass unnoticed.
recommended_fix: Assert the no-op explicitly: after the call, verify reviewForm._onSubmit stays undefined (or that addEventListener was never invoked).

title: test title promises "never goes negative" but no negative case is asserted
detail: Title claims "floors to whole seconds AND never goes negative," but the body only advances 5999ms and checks "5." No negative-duration (now < initMs) case is ever exercised here.
recommended_fix: Add a case where the clock moves backward (now < initMs) and assert clampFocusSeconds yields "0", not a negative value.
